Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1145 AM EST Sat Nov 7 2026

- Scattered showers taper off this morning with mostly cloudy and 
seasonable conditions the rest of the day.

- Slightly milder and breezy on Sunday.

- Temperatures stay on the warmer side of average through mid week 
before a cool down arrives late week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Cold cyclonic northwest flow (sustained winds at or above 10 knots) 
over Lower Michigan early this afternoon supporting MVFR cigs. Low 
level lapse rates are even steep enough to generate a touch of CAPE 
and pockets of drizzle/very light showers.

Excellent subsidence and warming at the 850 MB level by day's end 
looks to support clear-mostly clear skies this evening/tonight. 
Light southwest winds ahead of a cold front tonight will bring a 
renewed chance for high MVFR cigs late tomorrow morning, especially 
across MBS and FNT where the lake Michigan moisture contribution 
looks to be maximized. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceiling 5000 ft this afternoon becoming low this evening.
